name: hidden compounder
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Cyclical = 0 AND Market cap >= 3000 AND Market cap <= 75000 AND Institutional holding <= 35 AND ROCE >= 18 AND Growth sustained = 1 AND OPM change yoy >= -1.5 AND CFO to EBITDA >= 70 AND Debt to equity <= 0.5 AND PE core <= 40 AND Return 6m <= 30
description: Core hat: under-owned mid-cap compounder; ranked by gem score

name: quality fair price
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND ROCE >= 20 AND ROE >= 15 AND Debt to equity <= 0.5 AND CFO to EBITDA >= 70 AND PE core <= PE core universe median AND Core profit growth >= 10
description: Quality at a fair price: PE on core profit at or below the universe median

name: magic formula
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND ROCE >= 15 AND Magic formula rank >= 1
description: Greenblatt: top 15 by earnings-yield rank + ROCE rank

name: garp
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Sales yoy latest quarter >= 20 AND Sales yoy preceding quarter >= 15 AND Core profit growth >= Sales yoy latest quarter AND ROCE >= 15 AND PEG <= 1
description: Growth at a reasonable price on core profit growth

name: turnaround
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND OPM change yoy >= 3 AND Sales yoy latest quarter >= 10 AND PE <= 40 AND Return 6m <= 15

name: under owned
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Under owned = 1 AND ROCE >= 18 AND Core profit growth >= 15 AND Market cap < Market cap universe median
description: Under-owned with promoter skin in the game

name: cash machine
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND FCF to PAT >= 80 AND ROIC >= 25 AND Price to CFO <= 30 AND Working capital days <= 45
description: High-ROIC cash generators at a sane price to CFO

name: fallen quality
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Distance from 52w high <= -30 AND ROCE >= 18 AND Debt to equity <= 0.5 AND Core profit growth >= 0 AND (Piotroski score >= 6 OR Piotroski known = 0)
description: Contrarian: quality down 30% or more from its 52-week high

name: capex pay off
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Capex pay off signal = 1 AND ROCE >= 15 AND Sales yoy latest quarter >= 10
description: Capex cycle about to pay off

name: cyclicals
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Financial = 0 AND Cyclical = 1 AND ROCE >= 15 AND Sales yoy latest quarter >= 15
description: Cyclicals listed not ranked by PE (judged on OPM vs own history once it exists)

name: lenders
expression: Forensic clean = 1 AND Lender = 1 AND ROA >= 1.5 AND PB <= 2.5 AND YoY quarterly profit growth >= 15 AND (GNPA <= 3 OR GNPA known = 0)
description: Lenders: ROA at a sane P/B with profit growth; GNPA where filed
